topics.description: Child care fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with the US government launching an investigation into the matter. The investigation has led to the sentencing of at least one defendant and the tossing of a conviction for another.

The FBI has launched a terrorism investigation into a homemade explosive device ignited outside NYC Mayor Mamdani's residence. The investigation is ongoing, with the FBI raiding the homes of two Bucks County men accused of throwing the device.
